source.title: Water and rice in early Java and Bali
source.role: Dated rice presence in a named cultivated landscape; no yield or acreage target

records.source_locator: Printed pp.237-241 / PDF pp.246-250; ninth-century rice systems and tenth-century eastern lowland expansion
records.geographic_basis: Named central/east Java mainland systems plus Bali island; explicit native-province crosswalk excluding Madura, Kangean and Bawean. No extension to Lombok or western Java. This is regional crop presence inferred from the historical synthesis, not individual excavated field polygons.
records.interpretation: Rice dry and wet systems are established before1337. Availability does not assign water, hectares, double harvests or attained yields. The source distinguishes uncultivated lowlands and later management investment, which remain separate constraints.
